content:
Emily R: Heads up — noticed week-over-week drop in webinar-sourced MQLs after the launch. Dash shows ~44% drop Thu-Fri. Anyone else seeing this?

Maria L: saw that too. CTR on ads steady but ‘demo requested’ conversions down. Could be attribution window change? :thinking_face:

Josh P: I think our GA4 tag for the webinar landing updated last week — migration might've toggled session attribution. Pulling raw events.

analytics-bot: Query finished: webinar_form_submit events: 2026-03-15: 342, 2026-03-22: 191. Funnel drop localized to paid-social cohort.

Kevin S: Paid social UTM.medium=ppc? We cached some redirect in front of the landing last Friday for an A/B test. That could strip UTM params.

Maria L: Yikes. Which redirect? @Kevin S can you paste the redirect rule? We need to know if it strips query string.

Kevin S: it's in load-balancer rule 77. snippet:

```
if path == '/lp/webinar' then redirect to /lp/webinar-b with 302
```

(not preserving querystring). Fixing now.

Emily R: Ok if it strips UTMs, ad platform will show clicks but attribution won't attach to the form submit -> leads appear organic. That matches the drop.

Nina C: Propose two-step: 1) Roll forward fix to preserve querystring. 2) Re-ingest events for last 7 days with click_id join to reconcile leads. Agree?

Josh P: Agree. I'll re-run the event join job and push a delta table to the dashboard. ETA 2 hrs.

analytics-bot: Reingested click-join results: reconciled +127 MQLs to paid-social between 2026-03-22 and 2026-03-24. Updated KPIs in 'Launch Overview' card.

Emily R: Huge — thanks. Can we add a note to the dashboard that shows 'attributed via reingest' and update weekly alert thresholds so this doesn't trigger pager? :thumbsup:

Maria L: I'll update the dashboard blurb and adjust the alert window to 48h. Also logging this as postmortem for launch playbook.

Kevin S: Fix deployed. Redirect now preserves query string. Will add integration test.

Josh P: Closing loop: updated dashboard, running a quick validation across regions.
